title: 第1章 首秀扑街，精神小妹上门求收留！
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

魔都，繁华商业街。

顶着一头微分碎盖的江辰，死死盯着手机屏幕。

“完犊子！十万字首秀……又扑了！”

“上个月听读加全勤，稿费还有一千五，这个月要能有一千，除非……祖坟冒烟！”

长长叹了口气，他顶着厚重黑眼圈，扫视眼前城市的繁华。

随后低头一看，洗得褪色的衬衫，地摊上淘来的大裤衩，快“分家”的人字拖……

嗯，挺格格不入的。

“帅哥~要不要进来放松放松？”

一个嗲里嗲气的女人声音，飘然入耳。

江辰停下脚步，就见一个浓妆艳抹的女人，从‘晚风足浴店’门口走来。

大波浪，超短裙，渔网袜......

标准的职业套装，做什么的一目了然。

当她走到江辰面前时，空气中立刻弥漫起浓郁的香水味，呛得他胃里一阵翻江倒海。

“不...不用了，我家里还有事。”江辰手捂着鼻子说道。

女人媚然一笑：“帅哥，有心事？

看你这愁眉不展的样子，最适合上我们这放松放松了。

姐手法专业着呢，保准你下次还想来！”

说话间，她松开了领口处的扣子。

江辰瞳孔微缩，旋即四十五度角仰望星空。

“姐，你睁大眼睛好好看一下，我像是那种消费得起的人吗？”

他这一身的地摊货，加起来不超过两百块。

女人笑容不变，竖起那只美甲亮得发光的手指，“一百，怎么样？”

江辰叹了口气，转身欲走。

“一百还嫌贵？”女人皱了皱眉，而后一副壮士断腕的样子，道：

“五十！”

江辰依旧不为所动。

女子忙又道：“只要五十，姐今晚就是你的人了，你想怎样都行哦！”

怎样都行？

不得不说，这四个字所带来的诱惑力，让人很难拒绝。

“好，那你跟我走吧。”江辰答应得很爽快。

女人红唇微扬，对自己的魅力很是自信。

江辰走在前面带路。

因为价格低了，女人也不打算和江辰有过多的肢体接触。

到时，随便应付一下得了。

二人进入了城中村。

一眼望去，房屋鳞次栉比，几乎都是那种用来出租的廉价挂壁房。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Magic City, bustling commercial street.

Jiang Chen, who had a slightly broken hair on his head, stared at the screen of his mobile phone.

"What a bastard! My first show with 100,000 words... I'm here again!"

"Last month, I paid perfect attendance for listening and reading, and I still have a thousand and a half in manuscript fees. I will get a thousand this month, unless... there is smoke in the ancestral grave!"

With a long sigh, he glanced at the bustling city in front of him with thick dark circles under his eyes.

Then I looked down and saw the faded shirt, the big pants found on the street stall, the flip-flops that were about to be separated...

Hmm, quite out of place.

"Handsome~ Do you want to come in and relax?"

A cooing woman's voice floated in my ears.

Jiang Chen stopped and saw a woman with heavy makeup walking from the door of 'Wanfeng Foot Bath Shop'.

Big waves, miniskirt, fishnet stockings...

A standard professional suit, it’s clear what to do.

When she walked in front of Jiang Chen, the strong smell of perfume immediately filled the air, making his stomach churn.

"No... no need, I still have things to do at home." Jiang Chen said, covering his nose with his hand.

The woman smiled charmingly: "Handsome man, are you worried?

Judging from your gloomy look, it's best for you to come to our place to relax.

My skills are professional, I guarantee you’ll want to come again next time!"

As she spoke, she loosened the button at the collar.

Jiang Chen's pupils narrowed slightly, and he immediately looked up at the stars at a 45-degree angle.

"Sister, please open your eyes and take a good look. Do I look like the kind of person who can afford it?"

The total value of his street stall goods does not exceed 200 yuan.

The woman's smile remained unchanged, and she raised her finger with shining nails, "One hundred, how about it?"

Jiang Chen sighed and turned around to leave.

"Is one hundred too expensive?" The woman frowned, and then said as if a strong man had cut off his wrist:

"Fifty!"

Jiang Chen remained unmoved.

The woman hurriedly said: "As long as fifty, I will be yours tonight, sister. You can do whatever you want!"

Anything is fine?

I have to say that the temptation brought by these four words is difficult to refuse.

"Okay, then you come with me." Jiang Chen agreed readily.

The woman's red lips were slightly raised, and she was very confident in her own charm.

Jiang Chen walked in front and led the way.

Because the price was low, the woman did not intend to have too much physical contact with Jiang Chen.

When the time comes, just deal with it casually.

The two entered the urban village.

At a glance, there are rows of houses, almost all of which are cheap wall-mounted houses used for rent.
